bias.zh: 中性 · 波动极大，位于100日均线下方

read.en: Applied Optoelectronics swings about 9% a day on average, so signals flip quickly. It ran from $94 to $131 between mid-September and Oct 6, then gave back 19% in three sessions. Price now sits on its 10-day ($111) and 200-day ($111) averages, above the 30-day ($106) but well below the falling 100-day ($129). MACD is still above its signal but fading, RSI is 50, and Parabolic SAR remains below price at $101.
read.zh: Applied Optoelectronics 日均波幅约 9%，信号转换很快。股价由 9月中旬的 $94 涨至 10月6日的 $131，随后三个交易日回吐 19%。目前位于 10 日（$111）与 200 日（$111）均线上，高于 30 日线（$106），但远低于下行中的 100 日线（$129）。MACD 仍在信号线上方但减弱，RSI 为 50，抛物线 SAR 仍在股价下方的 $101。

read.en: The 100-day average and the Oct 6 high ($129–131) are the level that decides whether the rebound becomes a trend; $147 is next. On the downside, $101–102 (SAR and an August pivot) is first support, then the $93–97 area that held three times in September. A close below $93 would put the March lows near $85 back in view.
read.zh: 100 日均线与 10月6日高点（$129–131）是判断反弹能否演变为趋势的关键；其上为 $147。下方首个支撑为 $101–102（SAR 与8月转折点），其次是 9月三次守住的 $93–97。若收盘跌破 $93，将重新看向 3月低点 $85 附近。
